lines: Woh mera raunaq-e-mehfil kahan hai
couplets.en: Where is the one who lit up my gathering?

lines: Meri bijli, mera haasil kahan hai
couplets.en: Where is my lightning, all I ever gained?

lines: Maqaam us ka hai dil ki khalvaton mein
couplets.en: They dwell in the quiet chambers of the heart.

lines: Khuda jaane maqaam-e-dil kahan hai
couplets.en: God knows where the heart itself dwells.

lines: Jis din se juda woh hum se hue
couplets.en: They went away, and everything changed that day.

lines: Is dil ne dhadakna chhod diya
couplets.en: This heart stopped beating.

couplets.en: The stars have ceased to shine.
